text_block_list.text: —Well then, the race is finally upon us.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"It's alright, I'm not nervous.
The issues that arose last time have already been
resolved between the two of us."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
So... Trainer,
please wait and believe in my victory...!
